exposure: Pre-pregnancy BMI (normal weight, overweight, obese, >= 25 kg/m^2)
cohort: The study included 183 women with gestational diabetes, with an average age of 33.8 years.
finding: Ethnicity, maternal age, and pre-pregnancy BMI independently predicted insulin therapy and impacted various maternal and fetal outcomes at delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean section occurred more frequently in women aged >= 35 years compared to those < 35 years.
